title: Breaking And Entering: Beverly Glenn-Copeland On Music And Re-discovery
summary: Underground icon Beverly Glenn-Copeland has had an extraordinary career spanning over 40 years. He joins Simon and Lauren to reflect on his new retrospective compilation, Transmissions: The Music Of Beverly Glenn-Copeland. Drawing on Buddhist thought, he says that the music that connects most with others was often created beyond his abilities as an artist and he believes that it was transmitted to him by a higher means he labels the “universal broadcasting system”.
